services.desc: Parasailing is an incredible adventure and one of the top things to do in Punta Cana! The coastline from 200 feet up in the air as you set sail is absolutely breathtaking and a fun experience for all the family. There are certain weight restrictions for parasailing individually. The minimum weight for parasailing is 110 lb/50 kg and maximum weight of 400 lb/181kg. Guests weighing under 110 lb/50 kg will have to fly with another guest. services.desc: Get ready to experience a thrilling ride that redefines water sports. With no need for wind or waves, this high-powered electric surfboard lets you carve through the water and explore untouched coastal views with total freedom. After a safety briefing and quick intro lesson, you’ll gear up and start gliding through the waves on your electric board.
